understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to navigate each grid level, use modifier tiles to adjust the carried piece’s shape/color/rotation to exactly match each goal cell’s requirements, then step onto each correctly-matched goal cell to complete it; completing all goals in a level advances to the next level, and finishing all levels wins.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Each move (north/south/east/west) costs 1 stamina; when stamina hits 0 you lose 1 life and stamina resets to its maximum, and losing all lives ends the game. Walls prevent movement; the state provides blocked_directions that must never be chosen. Stepping on modifier tiles changes the carried piece: shape modifiers cycle shapes 0–5 (wrapping), color modifiers cycle colors in order orange→blue→green→red→orange, and rotation modifiers rotate 90° clockwise (0→90→180→270→0). A goal cell only activates/completes when the piece’s shape, color, and rotation all match the goal’s required values at the moment you step onto it.
